verdict.rationale: AngelList is a SaaS platform for equity, fundraising and fund administration, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but nothing in the evidence pack documents one. The llms.txt file (probe-1) only exposes help docs to LLMs and is a different capability. The OpenAPI probe (probe-2) found no API spec at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
